sentences.en: A stay of execution was ordered at the eleventh hour.
sentences.zh: 最后一刻下达了暂停执行的命令。

sentences.en: The crime scene had the earmarks of a professional execution.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场充满了专业人士执行的痕迹。

sentences.en: He forced the natives to witness the execution of their relatives.
sentences.zh: 他强迫土著人目睹他们亲人的执行过程。

senses.zh: 依法处决 - 实行, 执行 - 演奏, 技巧
